name: file-tools
description: Desktop local document parsing and PDF research for the Agent: parse_document (Office/PDF to Markdown), docx_patch (surgical text fixes inside an existing .docx, formatting preserved), pdf_structure / pdf_citations / pdf_page_text / pdf_region_text / pdf_formula_candidates (PDF structure, references, page and region text, formula candidates). OCR lives in ocr-tools, DWG in dwg-tools. All engines ship inside the installer and work offline.
